text:
kevin: Heads-up — our weekly eng sync (recurring invite) has been rotating Zoom links every occurrence and folks in APAC keep getting locked out. I joined today at 09:00 PT and the link in the calendar didn't match the host link :facepalm: Can someone check Calendar/Zoom settings?

maria: That's because the Zoom meeting was created as "Generate automatically" for each occurrence. Zoom UI: Recurring meeting -> Occurrence settings -> 'Generate automatically' vs 'Use same meeting ID'.

kevin: Ah — I probably clicked that when creating it quickly. Is there a way to fix the existing recurring events so the link is stable for future occurrences?

sylvia: Two options: change the Zoom meeting setting to 'Use same meeting ID' for the recurring meeting (if you have meeting owner rights), OR create a new meeting with the stable ID and update events. For existing Google Calendar events you can patch the meeting conferenceData with the new join URL.

jia: I can push a quick script to patch the next N occurrences via the Calendar API. Example snippet (python):
```
service.events().patch(calendarId='primary', eventId=eid, conferenceData={'entryPoints':[{'entryPointType':'video','uri':'https://zoom.us/j/123456789'}]}, conferenceDataVersion=1).execute()
```

devex: Two process asks: 1) don't rely on auto-generated links for recurring cross-timezone meetings; 2) put the stable link also in the event description and in the team calendar (eng-sync@redwood.com). That way if gcal drops conferencing it is still accessible.

calendar-bot: Notice: 3 attendees in APAC are in different timezones than event organizer. Suggest sending timezone-aware invite (start time in attendees' locale) — see https://support.google.com/calendar/answer/65935?hl=en

maria: Also set the Zoom account default for 'Recurring meeting ID' to 'Use same meeting ID' (Admin > Account Settings > Schedule Meeting). That stops new meetings from being created for each occurrence.

sylvia: For short-term fix: Kevin, can you create a new one-off meeting with stable ID and I'll update the next 4 calendar occurrences to point to it? Then update the recurring master to use stable ID to cover long-term.

kevin: I can do that. I'll create meeting, share link in #eng-platform, and tag @jia to run the patch script. ETA 30m.

jia: On it — will run script by EOD. I’ll also include a dry-run mode and post results. Script will log patched eventIds and write a CSV.

ops-bot: Reminder: Zoom capacity for meeting id 123456789 supports up to 300 participants; if you expect >100 please request higher capacity.

devex: Also proposing longer-term: move to one canonical calendar event (non-recurring) cloned per quarter per timezone and use a stable alias. We discussed before in RFC-ops-scheduling.

kevin: Agreed. For now new meeting created and patched. I'll also update the event description with dial-in numbers. Thanks all.
